text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the current extent of my<n>abilities...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be so careless,<n>especially not after
discovering such<n>a flaw in my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Perhaps it'd be best if I go<n>back to the
drawing board and start<n>from the ground up.

It'd be a shame if she abandoned all<n>her hard
work, but the choice is<n>ultimately hers.

It'd be a shame if she abandoned all<n>her hard
work, but the choice is<n>ultimately hers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I really appreciate you<n>helping me with
my theories and<n>calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. The path to success is<n>paved with
failure. Nothing I've done<n>has ever been a waste of
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, then! First, let's identify the<n>parts of the
strategy that did work. If<n>we do that, then—
choice_data_list: Your next race will end in victory instead!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll do whatever it takes to<n>perfect my winning
equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll strike the iron while it's hot<n>and rework
my calculations now<n>while my memory of the race
is still<n>fresh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back right away...<n>Wait—before we go
back, I need to<n>buy some bananas.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because the glucose they provide is<n>excellent for
boosting brain function.<n>They're essential for long
brainstorming sessions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For the record... I don't want to buy<n>them simply
because I want to eat<n>bananas!

Biwa Hayahide and I grab some<n>bananas from the
supermarket<n>before heading back, and then we put
in some long hours going over race<n>data.
